english.title: Fail to give name / address to a traffic officer in uniform when required - Traffic Management Act 2004
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to give your name and address to a traffic officer in uniform on being required to do so by that officer
english.legislation: Contrary to section 10(4) of the Traffic Management Act 2004.
